title: app.deployment_failed
description: A deployment stopped at a stage. `node_id` of the entry is the app node. The stage message is not in the journal (it can quote log lines); `getAppDeployment` shows it to callers with `edit`. This schema is the `data` of a journal entry with `type` `app.deployment_failed`. Step 3, planned (decision 0004-21, docs/STEP3.md).
